acc().details: Live pass-through to the trust accumulator.

checkpoint().details: Freezes the trust accumulator's CURRENT state into a local checkpoint. Never reverts      on an unchanged accumulator (see the contract-level dev note on the missing      `NoNewInputs` guard). Only the bound snapshot may mint (M6-1): both lanes must be      frozen under one id by `trigger()`, or the unset lane-2 freeze reads `(0, 0)`.

returns.id: The new checkpoint id (also its index).

params._trustAccumulator: The trust accumulator to mirror. Immutable: re-pointing the input        lane is a constitutional event on the snapshot (`setAccumulator` to a new mirror),        never a mutation here.

leafCount().details: Live pass-through to the trust accumulator.

bindSnapshot(address).notice: One-shot: bind the contributions `MerkleSnapshot` whose `trigger()` may mint         checkpoints. Deploy-time circularity (snapshot's constructor takes the mirror)         makes this a post-deploy call, mirroring the resolver's `setSchemas` pattern.

binder().notice: The deployer address allowed to perform the one-shot `bindSnapshot`.

checkpoint().notice: Freeze the current accumulator as a new checkpoint. Permissionless.

leafCount().notice: The number of edges folded so far.

snapshot().notice: The only address allowed to mint checkpoints (the contributions `MerkleSnapshot`,         whose `trigger()` freezes BOTH lanes under one id). Set once via `bindSnapshot`.

trustAccumulator().notice: The trust instance's accumulator this mirror reads (the live `EASIndexerResolver`).
